scope: generic observability architecture and measurement methodology, not private source code or company analysis
decisions: Correlate versioned component traces and evaluation records with operational run IDs
Keep instrumentation health, execution and research quality separate
Reject stale target/artifact/model/prompt/rubric evidence as a current pass
Synthetic and methodology-only checks do not establish company research quality
Successful retries do not erase earlier incomplete lifecycle evidence
State exact tested scope and missing live adapters
limitations: No implementation or live-company verification is implied
No price or paid invoice is implied by usage tokens
No global research plateau or scientific Phase 1D completion is established
